units.source_text: [\[4\]](#part1331.html#w4) 藏人所的长官称为别当，由左大臣兼。

en.t: The head of the Chamberlain's Office was called the Bettō, a post held concurrently by the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 下设“头”二人：一人由弁官兼任，称为头弁；另一人由中将兼任，称为头中将。

en.t: Below him were two officials called Tō: one was also a controller and was called the Tō no Ben, while the other was also a middle captain and was called the Tō no Chūjō.

units.source_text: 再下面是五位藏人三人，六位藏人四人。

en.t: Below them were three chamberlains of the fifth rank and four chamberlains of the sixth rank.
